I could not get the FISP coupon this year because the line at the chief's office was too long and the vouchers ran out before my turn came. I will plant the local maize seed I saved from last year's harvest on this small plot, and since I have no money for fertilizer, I will just clear the weeds and hope the rains are good. With only my children and me working, this half-acre piece will keep us busy for a few weeks, but it is small enough that we do not need to hire any ganyu labor.
